Equinix, Inc. ("Equinix") has elected Dr. Yanbing Li as an independent director to its Board of Directors (the "Board"), effective August 12, 2025. With the election of Dr. Li, Equinix's Board now consists of 9 members.
Dr. Li will serve as a member of the Board's Talent, Culture and Compensation Committee.
As member of Equinix's Board, Dr. Li will receive Equinix's standard compensation for non-employee directors.
A copy of Equinix's press release relating to the election of Dr. Li as a director is being furnished as Exhibit 99.1 to this Current Report on Form 8-K.
